source_title: G20 foreign ministers to end Atlanta meeting without consensus on key issues
source_excerpt: Atlanta Top diplomats from the Group of 20 (G20) largest world economies will wrap up two days of talks in Atlanta on Saturday (October 31, 2026) without reaching consensus on several critical global security issues, after divisions, notably over Russia’s war with Ukraine, overshadowed the start of the meeting. https://www.thehindu.com/topic/russia-ukraine-crisis/ As a result, the group will not release a joint communique, but will rely on a chairman’s statement summarising the talks, which U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio will release at the conclusion, according to diplomats who attended.
